info.title: Luanti Education Platform
info.description: Interface of the LEP backend for the web frontend and the worlds.

get.summary:
Returns the jobs that wait for the agent. If there are none, the
request stays open for up to `wait` seconds and returns as soon as
one comes.

200.description: The waiting jobs, possibly none

post.summary: Notes how a job for the agent went.

200.description: Noted

404.description: The agent has no such job

post.summary: Takes in what the agent says about the game server.

200.description: Noted

get.summary:
Says whether the backend can do its work, and nothing else: everybody
may ask. The details are for teachers, under `/api/web/v1/status`.

200.description: State of the backend

post.summary:
Confirms the address a teacher entered at the desk, with the token
from the confirmation mail. A token works once.

200.description: The address is confirmed

400.description: The token is unknown, used or too old (invalid_token), or the request cannot be read (invalid_request)

409.description: The address belongs to another account (address_taken)

get.summary:
Lists the groups of the teacher: all of them for the school
administration, else the ones the teacher is assigned to.

200.description: The groups the teacher may see

post.summary:
Creates a group and asks the agent to set its world up. Only the
school administration may do this.

200.description: The new group, its world still pending

409.description: Another group has this name (name_taken), or there is no agent that could set the world up (no_game_server)

get.summary:
Shows one group. A group the teacher may not see does not exist for
them.

200.description: The group

404.description: No such group for this teacher (not_found)

delete.summary:
Removes a group whose world the agent refused. Such a world never
existed. Only the school administration may do this.

200.description: The group is gone

404.description: No such group (not_found)

409.description: The agent did not refuse this group (wrong_state)

patch.summary:
Renames a group, sets its teachers or both. Only the school
administration may do this.

200.description: The group as it is now

400.description: The name cannot be used or an account is not a teacher (invalid_request)

404.description: No such group (not_found)

get.summary:
Keeps the request open and sends an event named "change" whenever a
part of the group changed. Its data is one of the words of
`ChangeTopic`, never the changed data itself: the page loads that
part again. The request ends when the session does, and when the
backend stops.

200.description: A stream of server-sent events named "change", each with a ChangeTopic as data

404.description: No such group, or not one of the teacher (not_found)

get.summary:
Shows where the students of a group stand: level and workload per
module, and the trophies. It is what the world reported last.

200.description: The modules of the world and the students whose accounts exist

404.description: No such group, or not one of the teacher (not_found)

get.summary:
Returns where the students of a group stand as a CSV file to
download: one line per student and module, cells separated by
semicolons. The file leaves the platform: who exports it answers for
it, and the export is written into the protocol "exports".

200.description: The progress as a CSV file

404.description: No such group, or not one of the teacher (not_found)

post.summary:
Orders the level new students start a module on. It counts for
every student the world has stored nothing about in this module;
who has started stays where they are. The world makes the change and
reports it with its modules; until then the answer shows the old
level with the change as pending.

200.description: The progress of the group, with the change on its way

400.description: The module has no such level (invalid_request)

404.description: No such group, not one of the teacher, or no such module (not_found)

post.summary:
Orders a new level, a lock or both for a student in a module. The
world makes the change and reports the new state; until then the
answer shows the old state with the change as pending.

200.description: The progress of the group, with the change on its way

400.description: No such level, or nothing to change (invalid_request)

404.description: No such group, no such account that exists in the world, or no such module (not_found)

get.summary:
Shows a part of a protocol of the world of a group, newest entries
first: chat, signs, rewards, desk or names. A page has 100 entries.

parameters.name: protocol
parameters.description: chat, signs, rewards, names, desk or exports

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only entries from this time on, in seconds since 1970

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Only entries older than the one with this id: the next page

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Only entries that arrived after the one with this id

200.description: A part of the protocol

403.description: The protocol of the desk or of the exports, and not the school administration (forbidden)

404.description: No such group, not one of the teacher, or no such protocol (not_found)

get.summary:
Returns the filtered entries of a protocol as a CSV file to download,
oldest first, with times in UTC and cells separated by semicolons.
The file leaves the platform: who exports it answers for it, and
every export is written into the protocol "exports".

parameters.name: protocol
parameters.description: chat, signs, rewards, names, desk or exports

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only entries from this time on, in seconds since 1970

200.description: The entries as a CSV file

403.description: The protocol of the desk or of the exports, and not the school administration (forbidden)

404.description: No such group, not one of the teacher, or no such protocol (not_found)

get.summary:
Returns the reward table of a group: what is paid for which
occasion, and the items that can be chosen.

200.description: The reward table of the group

404.description: No such group, or not one of the teacher (not_found)

put.summary:
Orders a new reward table for a group, or the default of its world
if no table is given. The world checks it, takes it as a whole or
not at all, and reports the table it has then. It counts from the
next reward on.

200.description: The table that counts, with the change on its way

400.description: A count or the daily limit is out of range, an item cannot be chosen, or the world has not reported its table yet (invalid_request)

404.description: No such group, or not one of the teacher (not_found)

post.summary:
Asks the agent again to set up the world of a group it refused. Only
the school administration may do this.

200.description: The group, its world pending again

404.description: No such group (not_found)

409.description: The agent did not refuse this group (wrong_state)

get.summary: Lists the accounts of the students of a group.

200.description: The accounts, in the order they were rolled

404.description: No such group for this teacher (not_found)

post.summary:
Rolls names for new accounts. Nothing happens in the world yet: the
names are drafts that can be rolled again or removed.

200.description: All accounts of the group

400.description: The count is not allowed or the group would get too large (invalid_request)

404.description: No such group for this teacher (not_found)

post.summary:
Has the world create an account for every draft of the group and
returns the access slips with the start passwords. The passwords are
shown this once: the backend does not keep them.

200.description: The access slips, shown once

400.description: There is no draft to create (invalid_request)

404.description: No such group for this teacher (not_found)

delete.summary: Removes a name that is not an account in the world.

200.description: All accounts of the group

404.description: No such group, or no such name that could still be changed (not_found)

delete.summary:
Orders the world to take the display name of a student away. The
student may choose a new one right away, unless choosing is locked.
The answer shows the list with the order on its way.

200.description: The students of the group

404.description: No such group, or no such account that exists in the world (not_found)

post.summary:
Orders the world to lock or unlock choosing a display name for a
student. A lock does not take the name away.

200.description: The students of the group

404.description: No such group, or no such account that exists in the world (not_found)

get.summary:
Shows what happened to the display name of a student, newest first.
It is read from a protocol of the world and is deleted with it.

200.description: The history of the display names

404.description: No such group, or no such account that exists in the world (not_found)

post.summary:
Makes up a new start password for the account of a student and asks
the world to set it. The password is shown this once. Until the world
has set it, the old one counts.

parameters.name: account
parameters.description: The account that gets a new password

200.description: One access slip, shown once

404.description: No such group, or no such account that exists in the world (not_found)

post.summary:
Orders the world to delete the account of a student with everything
it knows about it. The backend deletes its copies when the world
reports that it did. A teacher of the group takes back an account
nobody ever logged in with; a used one only the school
administration deletes. It cannot be undone.

200.description: The students of the group, with the order on its way

400.description: The request does not carry the account name as confirmation (invalid_request)

403.description: The account was used: only the school administration deletes it (forbidden)

404.description: No such group, or no such account that exists in the world (not_found)

delete.summary:
Takes back the order to delete an account, as long as the world has
not answered.

200.description: The students of the group

404.description: No such group, or no order that waits for this account (not_found)

post.summary: Replaces a name that is not an account yet by a newly rolled one.

200.description: All accounts of the group

404.description: No such group, or no such name that could still be changed (not_found)

post.summary:
Starts or stops the world of a group, or starts it anew. The teachers
of the group and the school administration may do this. For everybody
else the group does not exist.

200.description: The group, with what the agent was asked to do

404.description: No such group for this teacher (not_found)

409.description: The agent does not run this world (wrong_state)

post.summary:
Logs a teacher in with the token from a login mail and sets the
session cookie. A token works once.

200.description: Logged in, the session cookie is set

400.description: The token is unknown, used or too old (invalid_token), or the request cannot be read (invalid_request)

post.summary:
Sends a mail with a login link to an address, if a teacher may log in
with it. The answer is the same in every case, so nobody learns here
which addresses are known.

200.description: Taken note of, whether or not a mail goes out

post.summary:
Ends the session of the request and removes the cookie. Without a
session nothing happens.

200.description: Logged out
The teacher of this session

get.summary:
Lists the accounts that were deleted on request: who, when, which
account, in which group. Nothing else is kept about them.

200.description: The deleted accounts, newest first

get.summary: Lists the accounts of all teachers, for the school administration.

200.description: The accounts of the teachers

post.summary:
Has every world create the account of a teacher, with the privileges
of the bundle for teachers. The answer carries the slip with the
start password, once: it is stored nowhere.

200.description: The access slip of the new teacher

400.description: The name cannot be an account name, or there is no world (invalid_request)

409.description: The name is taken or was deleted (account_taken)

post.summary:
Has every world set a new start password for a teacher. Accounts of
the school administration are never changed from here.

200.description: The access slip with the new password

403.description: Not the school administration, or the account is protected (forbidden)

404.description: No such teacher (not_found)

post.summary:
Orders every world to delete the account of a teacher. The backend
deletes address, web access and assignments when the first world
reports that it did. It cannot be undone.

200.description: The accounts of the teachers, with the order on its way

400.description: The request does not carry the account name as confirmation (invalid_request)

403.description: Not the school administration, or the account is protected (forbidden)

404.description: No such teacher (not_found)

get.summary:
Says how the backend is doing, with the details that are nobody
else's business.

200.description: State of the backend

get.summary:
Lists the accounts that can be assigned to groups. Only the school
administration may ask.

200.description: Everybody who holds the privilege for web access

get.summary:
Shows what closing the year would delete per group, how far the
worlds are with the last one, and when the year was closed before.

200.description: What would be deleted, and the years that were closed

post.summary:
Closes the year for the whole school: deletes all protocols and the
list of exports in the backend and orders every world to delete its
own protocols. What students have reached stays. It cannot be undone.

200.description: The year is closed; the worlds delete as soon as they answer

400.description: The request does not carry the confirmation (invalid_request)

post.summary:
Takes in events of a world. Every event is handled once, however often
it is sent.

200.description: One result per event

413.description: Too many events in one request

get.summary:
Returns the jobs that wait for a world. If there are none, the request
stays open for up to `wait` seconds and returns as soon as one comes.

200.description: The waiting jobs, possibly none

post.summary: Notes how a job went.

200.description: Noted

404.description: The world has no such job

AccessSlip.description: What a student needs to log in for the first time.

password.description:
The start password. The backend shows it this once and does
not keep it.

AccessSlips.description: Answer to creating accounts: the slips to print.

AccountRemoved.description:
Payload of the event "account_removed". The backend deletes its
copies when it arrives and keeps a note for good.

by.description:
Account name of who ordered it. Missing if nobody did from
outside.

AccountsCreated.description:
Payload of the event "accounts_created": what became of the
accounts a world was asked to create.

created.description: Names of the accounts that exist now, with the start password.

refused.description:
Names that were refused: taken by somebody else in this world,
or not a name the engine accepts. Nothing was changed for them.

AgentReport.description: What the agent says about the game server without being asked.

free_disk_bytes.description: Free space on the disk that holds the worlds, in bytes.

host.description:
Name under which players reach the game server, from the
settings of the agent. Missing if they name none.

template.description:
Version of the template for worlds the agent carries. Missing
if it was built without one or could not unpack it.

version.description: Version of the agent, as in its package.

worlds.description: The worlds the agent looks after.

ApiError.description: Answer to a request that failed.

message.description:
What went wrong, in English, for logs and developers. It is not
shown to users.

ArrivalState.description:
How far the account of a teacher is in one world, as the world
answered the orders of the backend.

ChangeState.description: How far a change a teacher ordered is.

ChangeTopic.description:
A part of a group that changed. The way
`/api/web/v1/groups/{id}/changes` sends it as the data of an event
named "change"; a page then loads that part again.

by.description: Account name of who closed the year, for the log of the world.

ConfirmRequest.description: Request to confirm an address with the token from a mail.

account.description: Account name of the teacher the address now belongs to.

by.description:
Account name of who ordered it, for accounts of teachers. The
world writes it into the protocol of the desk.

teacher.description:
True if the accounts are for teachers: the world gives them
the privileges of the bundle for teachers. Only the school
administration orders that.

CreateWorld.description:
Payload of the job that creates a world and starts it. For a
world that exists already, only the key of the bridge is written
again.

bridge_key.description: Key the bridge of the world calls the backend with.

world.description:
Fixed identifier of the world. The folder of the world is named
after it.

DisplayLock.description: Request to lock or unlock choosing a display name.

DisplayName.description:
Payload of the event "display_name": what an account is shown
under in the world. Always the whole state of the account.

changed_at.description:
When the player chose a name last, in seconds since 1970.
Missing or null if never, or after a teacher took it away.

locked.description: True if a teacher has locked choosing a name.

name.description:
The name the player chose. Missing or null while the account
name is shown.

DisplayNameAction.description: What can happen to a display name.

DisplayNameEntry.description: One entry of the history of the display names of a student.

by.description: Account name of who did it: the student, or a teacher.

name.description:
The name that was chosen, given up or taken away. Missing for
a lock.

time.description: When it happened, in seconds since 1970.

DisplayNameHistory.description:
The history of the display names of a student, newest first. It
comes from a protocol of the world and is deleted with it.

Done.description: Answer to a request that needs nothing said.

DraftRequest.description: Request to roll names for new accounts.

EarnedTrophy.description: A trophy a student has earned.

title.description: Name for people, in the language of the world.

ErrorCode.description:
Why a request failed, as a fixed word. The frontend translates it into
the language of the user.

Event.description: One thing that happened in a world.

id.description:
Unique id, made up by the world. The backend uses it to notice
an event it has seen before.

kind.description:
What happened, for example "world_started". It decides what
the payload has to look like.

payload.description: The details, depending on the kind.

time.description: When it happened, in seconds since 1970 (UTC).

EventBatch.description: Several events in one request, oldest first.

EventBatchResult.description: Answer to a batch: one result per event, in the same order.

EventOutcome.description:
What the backend did with an event. In every case the world may
forget the event: sending it again would change nothing.

EventResult.description: The outcome for one event of a batch.

GameServer.description:
The game server that runs the worlds, as its agent last described
it.

connected.description: True if the agent reported a short while ago.

free_disk_bytes.description: Free space on the disk that holds the worlds, in bytes.

last_seen_at.description:
When the agent last reported, in seconds since 1970. Missing
if it never did.

template.description:
Version of the template for worlds the agent carries. Missing
if it has none: then it cannot create worlds.

Group.description: A group. It is the home of one world, one to one.

address.description:
Where players reach the world, for example
`spiel.schule.example, Port 30000`. It is printed on the
access slips. Missing until somebody entered it.

address_fixed.description:
True if the address comes from the agent. Then nobody enters
it by hand.

id.description: Fixed identifier of the group and its world.

last_seen_at.description:
When the world of the group last called, in seconds since
1970 (UTC). Missing if it never did.

name.description: Name for people. It can be changed.

port.description: Port players reach the world on, once the agent created it.

refusal.description:
Why the agent refused to set the world up, in its own words.
Only with `refused`.

oneOf.description:
What the agent was asked to do with the world and has not
answered yet.

step_refusal.description:
Why the agent refused the last thing it was asked to do with
the world, in its own words.

teachers.description:
Account names of the teachers who are assigned to the group,
sorted.

world.description: How it stands with the world of the group on the game server.

address.description:
Where players reach the world, if it changes. An empty text
removes it.

name.description: The new name, if it changes.

teachers.description:
The teachers of the group from now on, if they change. The
list replaces the old one.

GroupProgress.description:
The progress of a group: the modules of its world and the
students whose accounts exist, in the order of the list of
students.

GroupRewards.description: The reward table of a group, as its world reported it.

oneOf.description: Missing in the usual case: no change is on its way.

choices.description: The items that can be chosen.

max_count.description:
The most that can be paid for one occasion, before the effort
multiplies it.

max_daily_limit.description: The highest number of rewarded daily tasks per day.

oneOf.description: Missing as long as the world has not reported its table.

Groups.description: The groups a teacher may see.

Health.description:
Answer of the health check. Everybody may ask, so it says nothing
but whether the backend can do its work.

HealthStatus.description: Whether the backend can do its work.

Job.description: Something the backend wants a world to do.

kind.description:
What to do, for example "ping". It decides what the payload has
to look like.

JobList.description: The jobs that wait for a world. Empty if none came in time.

message.description: A short note, for example why it failed.

Level.description: One level of a module: its workload.

stage.description: True if completing this level ends a stage of the module.

LoginLinkRequest.description: Request for a mail with a link that logs in.

email.description: The confirmed address of the teacher.

LoginRequest.description: Request to log in with the token from a mail.

Me.description: The teacher who is logged in.

email.description: The confirmed address of the teacher.

expires_at.description: When the session ends, in seconds since 1970 (UTC).

school_admin.description:
True if the teacher belongs to the school administration:
they see every group and assign teachers to groups.

worlds.description:
Names of the worlds in which the teacher holds the privilege
for web access.

Module.description: A learning module as a world knows it.

start_level.description:
The level players start on about whom the world has stored
nothing in this module yet. 1 if a world does not say.

title.description: Name for people, in the language of the world.

ModuleProgress.description: Where a student stands in one module.

oneOf.description: Missing in the usual case: no change is on its way.

completed.description: True if the whole module is completed.

locked.description: True if moving up after a completed level is locked.

percent.description: Share of the workload of the level that is done, 0 to 100.

started.description:
False if the world has reported nothing yet: the student
stands at the start of level 1.

tasks.description: The kinds of tasks of the current level.

Modules.description:
Payload of the event "modules": all modules of the world. It
replaces what the backend knew before.

NewAccount.description: An account a world shall create.

entry.description:
For a teacher, instead of the password: what the engine
stores of it, a salt and a verifier. The password cannot be
worked out from it, and every world gets the same. The world
marks such an account: its password is managed in the web
application and cannot be changed in the game.

password.description:
The start password. The world stores only its hash. Missing
if `entry` is given.

NewGroup.description: Request to create a group. Its world is set up by the agent.

PasswordState.description: How far a new start password for an account is.

Progress.description:
Payload of the event "progress": where one student stands in one
module. It is the whole state, not a change, and replaces what the
backend knew before.

completed.description: True if the whole module is completed.

locked.description: True if moving up after a completed level is locked.

percent.description: Share of the workload of the level that is done, 0 to 100.

tasks.description: The kinds of tasks of the current level.

ProgressChange.description:
Request to change where a student stands in a module. At least
one of the two has to be there.

level.description: The new level, if it changes.

locked.description: Whether moving up is locked from now on, if that changes.

ProgressModule.description: A learning module of the world of a group.

levels.description: How many levels the module has.

oneOf.description:
Missing in the usual case: no change of the start level is
on its way.

start_level.description:
The level students start on about whom the world has stored
nothing in this module yet.

title.description: Name for people, in the language of the world.

ProgressTask.description: How far a student is with one kind of task of their level.

title.description: Name for people, in the language of the world.

ProtocolEntry.description:
Payload of the event "protocol": one entry of one of the protocols
of a world. The time is the time of the event.

account.description:
Account name of the player the entry is about. Never a display
name.

fields.description: The other columns of the entry, by name.

ProtocolPage.description: A part of a protocol, newest entries first.

columns.description:
The columns of this protocol besides time and account, in the
order to show them.

more.description:
True if there are older entries than the last one here. Ask
for them with `before` set to its id.

ProtocolRow.description: One entry of a protocol of a world.

account.description: Account name of who did it.

display_name.description:
The display name the account has now. Protocols only keep
the account name.

fields.description: The other columns of the entry.

id.description:
Number of the entry in the backend. Entries that arrived
later have a larger one.

time.description: When it happened in the world, in seconds since 1970.

Removal.description:
The note that an account was deleted. It carries no content and
is kept for good.

by.description:
Account name of who ordered it. Missing if it was done in the
world itself.

group.description: Name of the group the account belonged to.

time.description: When the world reported it, in seconds since 1970.

RemovalRefusal.description: Why a world did not delete an account.

RemovalRequest.description: Request to delete the account of a student for good.

confirm.description: The account name, typed in once more.

Removals.description: The accounts that were deleted on request, newest first.

RemoveAccount.description:
Payload of the job "remove_account". The world answers with a
fixed word: "removed", or why not, see `web::RemovalRefusal`.

by.description: Account name of who ordered it.

only_unused.description:
True if the account may only be deleted when nobody ever
logged in with it: a teacher takes back what they created.
The world checks that itself.

staff.description:
True if the order is meant for a teacher. The world still
refuses the admin and the school administration.

RemoveDisplayName.description:
Payload of the job "remove_display_name". The world writes it
into the protocol of the names, under the account of the teacher.

by.description: Account name of the teacher who ordered it.

RewardChoice.description: An item a teacher may choose as a reward.

title.description: Name for people, in the language of the world.

RewardRow.description:
What is paid for one occasion: an item and how many. How hard a
task or a module was multiplies the count.

name.description: Technical name of the item, like "default:diamond".

RewardTable.description: The reward table of a world, which is the one of a group.

daily_limit.description: How many daily tasks are rewarded per student and day.

task.description: For a solved level task that counts for the workload.

RewardsChange.description: Request to set the reward table of a group.

oneOf.description: The new table. Missing to put the default of the world back.

SetDisplayLocked.description:
Payload of the job "set_display_locked". The world writes it into
the protocol of the names, under the account of the teacher.

by.description: Account name of the teacher who ordered it.

locked.description: True to lock choosing a name, false to unlock it.

SetLevel.description:
Payload of the job "set_level". The world writes the change into
the protocol of the desk, under the account of the teacher.

by.description: Account name of the teacher who ordered it.

SetLocked.description:
Payload of the job "set_locked". The world writes the change into
the protocol of the desk, under the account of the teacher.

by.description: Account name of the teacher who ordered it.

locked.description:
True to lock moving up after a completed level, false to
unlock it.

SetPassword.description:
Payload of the job "set_password". A world sets the password only
for an ordinary account: one that holds nothing but what every new
player gets.

by.description: Account name of who ordered it, for accounts of teachers.

password.description: The new start password. The world stores only its hash.

staff.description:
True if the order is meant for a teacher. The world still
refuses the admin and the school administration.

SetPasswordEntry.description:
Payload of the job "set_password_entry": a new password for a
teacher, as a salt and a verifier. A world takes it only for
accounts it created with such an entry, and never for its admin.

by.description:
Account name of who ordered it: a member of the school
administration, or the teacher. The world writes it into the
protocol of the desk.

SetRewards.description:
Payload of the job "set_rewards". The world checks the table,
takes it as a whole or not at all, and writes the change into
the protocol of the desk. It answers with a fixed word: "set", or
the row that is wrong.

by.description: Account name of the teacher who ordered it.

oneOf.description: The new table. Missing to put the default back.

SetStartLevel.description:
Payload of the job "set_start_level". The world writes the change
into the protocol of the desk, under the account of the teacher.

by.description: Account name of the teacher who ordered it.

level.description: The level new players start on, counted from 1.

StaffAccount.description: The account of a teacher, as the school administration sees it.

groups.description: Names of the groups the teacher is assigned to, sorted.

holder.description:
True if the account holds the privilege for web access in at
least one world.

oneOf.description: Missing in the usual case, see `Student::password`.
Missing in the usual case, see `Student::removal`.

school_admin.description:
True if it belongs to the school administration. Such an
account is never changed from here.

oneOf.description:
Missing for an account that was not created here, for example
the one of the admin.

worlds.description:
How far the account is in every world, sorted by the name of
the group. Empty for an account that was not created here:
the backend never gave an order about it.

StaffCreate.description: Request to create the account of a teacher.

name.description: The account name the school administration chose.

StaffList.description: The accounts of all teachers, sorted by name.

StaffState.description:
How far the account of a teacher is that the school
administration ordered.

StaffWorld.description: The account of a teacher in one world.

StartLevelChange.description: Request to set the level new students start a module on.

Status.description:
State of the backend with its details, for teachers who are
logged in.

oneOf.description:
The game server, as its agent last described it. Missing as
long as no agent is set up.

version.description: Version of the backend, as in its package.

account.description: Account name. It says nothing about the person.

oneOf.description:
Missing in the usual case: no change to the display name or
its lock is on its way.

display_changed_at.description: When the student chose that name, in seconds since 1970.

display_locked.description: True if a teacher has locked choosing a name.

display_name.description:
The name the student chose to be shown under in the world.
Missing while the account name is shown.

oneOf.description:
Missing in the usual case: the password the student was given
last is the one that counts.

Missing in the usual case: nobody has ordered to delete the
account. Pending while the world has not answered; the
account disappears from the list once it has deleted it.
Why the world refused to delete the account.

used.description:
True if somebody has ever logged in with the account, as far
as the world has said.

StudentProgress.description:
Where a student stands: one entry per module of the world, in the
order of the modules, and the trophies.

display_name.description: The name the student chose to be shown under in the world.

StudentState.description: How far the account of a student is.

Students.description:
The accounts of the students of a group, in the order they were
rolled. A name that is rolled again keeps its place.

TaskProgress.description: How far a student is with one kind of task of their level.

TaskType.description: A kind of task of a level, with how often it has to be solved.

title.description: Name for people, in the language of the world.

TeacherList.description:
The accounts that can be assigned to groups: everybody who holds
the privilege for web access in some world. Sorted.

Teachers.description:
Payload of the event "teachers": the accounts that hold the
privilege for web access in this world. It replaces what the
backend knew before.

school_admins.description:
The accounts that hold the privilege of the school
administration in this world.

Trophies.description:
Payload of the event "trophies": all trophies of one student. It
replaces what the backend knew before.

Trophy.description: A trophy a student has earned.

title.description: Name for people, in the language of the world.

WebAccessAction.description: What a teacher can do with their web access at the desk.

WebAccessRequest.description:
Payload of the event "web_access": what a teacher did with their
web access.

email.description: The address, for the action "set" only.

WebAccessState.description: How the web access of a teacher stands.

WebAccessStatus.description:
Payload of the job "web_access_status": how the web access of a
teacher stands. Addresses are shortened, the world never gets a
whole one back.

address.description: The confirmed address, shortened. Missing without one.

pending.description: The address that waits for its confirmation, shortened.

WorldJob.description: Payload of a job that names nothing but a world.

WorldOrder.description: Request to start or stop the world of a group.

WorldSetup.description: How it stands with the world of a group on the game server.

engine.description: Version of the game engine, as it names itself.

mods.description: Names of the mods that are loaded.

WorldState.description: A world as the agent has it on the game server.

id.description: Fixed identifier of the world, as the backend gave it.

port.description: Port players reach the world on.

template.description: Version of the template the world uses.

WorldStep.description: What can be done with a world that the agent runs.

YearEnd.description: What closing the year would delete, and when it was closed last.

runs.description: The years that were closed, newest first.

YearEndGroup.description:
What closing the year would delete for one group, and how far its
world is with the last one.

exports.description: Entries of the list of exports.

protocol_entries.description: Entries of protocols the backend holds for the group.

oneOf.description:
Missing if the world was never asked to delete its protocols,
or has done so. Pending: it has not answered yet, for example
because it does not run. Refused: it could not.

YearEndRun.description: A year that was closed. Kept for good, without any content.

account.description: Account name of who did it.

exports.description: How many entries of the list of exports it deleted.

protocol_entries.description: How many entries of protocols the backend deleted.
